Sen. Susan Collins (ME-R) cast the deciding vote to confirm Brett Kavanaugh in 2018. He then helped overturn Roe v. Wade four years later. Now she’s battling for her Senate seat in the upcoming midterm against Democrat Troy Jackson, and abortion rights groups are betting that voters haven’t forgotten how she contributed to the fall of Roe.

snippet.description:
When Your UPSC Dream Is Bigger Than the Struggle.

The UPSC journey is not easy. There will be long hours, self-doubt, setbacks and moments when giving up feels easier. But when the dream matters enough, the struggle becomes part of the journey.

This video is for every UPSC aspirant who is still preparing, still working, and still choosing to move forward despite the challenges.

Your dream is bigger than one bad day, one failed attempt, or one difficult phase.

Keep going. Keep working. Keep believing in the journey.

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, UPSC CSE 2028 or beyond, let this be your reminder to stay consistent and keep moving.
